summary: Completed single-seed fused retry reproduces 5566/4406 bbs formal hits, versus same-tail raw 5594/4457. No fabricated GT, accuracy self-normalization, or phantom completed result found. Exact functional-start parity, raw Mask/all-candidate replay and current parent retention remain unverified.
claim_blockers: Performance promotion: 4406 strict hits is 348 below 4754 and 51 below the raw control.
Exact functional equivalence and exclusive attribution of each changed hit to Mask support are not established under the amended E0 gate.
Independent full-model restoration requires current byte verification of both referenced parent checkpoints.
No completed new all-candidate or matching diagnostic is certified in this audit.

A.name: Ground truth provenance
A.details: ScanRefer object IDs select dataset scene boxes and point-membership masks. Archived native evaluator is called on final predictions; its counts are cross-checked. Original dataset bytes and upstream repository are not independently replayed.

B.name: Score normalization
B.details: Ordinary IoU, strict >0.25 and >0.50 thresholds, fixed expression-count denominators. All saved selected/coarse row decisions reproduce on CPU. Deployed sizes are floored at 1e-6.

C.name: Result existence and evidence
C.details: All intake entries, result counts, exits, source and checkpoint hashes agree. Original G is receipt-verified separately from G-continuation. Checkpoint delta/archive bytes and optimizer metadata verified; current parent bytes, original-G row arrays, raw binary masks and all candidate arrays unavailable.

D.name: Live versus dead code
D.details: Reported native REC/Mask paths and final-box overwrite are live. Inherited verify_native_replacement witness is unreachable because all step calls use update=True; auxiliary helpers/output paths are not credited as evidence.

E.name: Scope and attribution
E.details: One seed (2027), one dataset, one fit pass. Holdout previously seen in pretraining; formal validation is development evidence. Shared architecture/source/order but documented E0 query/box/Mask differences prevent exact functional parity or exclusive per-hit causal attribution. Same-query geometry is internal evidence, not an independent trained ablation.

F.name: Evaluation classification
F.details: REC and Mask targets are dataset-derived. Saved GT-assisted candidate oracle flags are diagnostic upper bounds, not deployable accuracy or semantic identity evidence.
